# Documentation Templates

Use these templates when adding new project documentation:

- [Core document](./core-document-template.md)
- [Reference document](./reference-document-template.md)
- [Implementation plan](./implementation-plan-template.md)
- [Implementation status dashboard](./implementation-status-template.md)
- [Architecture decision record](./adr-template.md)

For implementation work, copy the implementation-plan template into the relevant
milestone folder under `docs/impl-plan/`, then adjust the dashboard link for that
file's relative path.
